name: Dual Mesh Building
definition: Builds a dual mesh from per-cell vertices. One quad is created around every crossed edge from the per-cell vertices (aligned with its.cell_indices), split into triangles and welded into an indexed mesh.
summary: Dual Mesh Building constructs watertight quadrilateral meshes from scalar volumes by mapping Marching Cubes polygons to dual vertices, yielding better-shaped elements and fewer vertices than standard methods.
